edits.before: SL02: 'AI agents are becoming autonomous economic actors, but no rigorous empirical research exists' + SL03: 'Policymakers designing AI institutions will operate blind without empirical data from controlled experiments'
edits.after: Merged slide: 'AI agents are becoming economic actors, but policymakers and educators lack empirical data to guide them'
edits.reason: Both slides address the problem/gap. SL02 establishes the research gap; SL03 explains consequences. Combined into single problem statement with 'so what' built in. Reduces redundant setup.

edits.before: SL06: 'This research can showcase Soneium ecosystem while generating unique educational data' + SL07: 'Real-asset stakes create more realistic AI behavior than pure simulations'
edits.after: Merged slide: 'Real-asset blockchain research generates unique data while showcasing Soneium ecosystem potential'
edits.reason: Both slides justify the approach. SL07's research value argument strengthens SL06's Soneium fit. Combined: one slide on 'why this approach works for both parties.'

edits.before: 'Nyx can execute where Google, OpenAI, and universities face regulatory barriers'
edits.after: 'Only a private research foundation like Nyx can run this experiment—universities and corporations face structural barriers'
edits.reason: Tighten title to be more assertion-forward. Original implies comparison; rewrite states the unique positioning directly.

edits.before: SL09: 'Human researchers monitor and can intervene—AI agents operate within defined rule constraints' + SL10: 'Private chain with custom tokens eliminates public crypto speculation and brand risk'
edits.after: Merged slide: 'Human oversight, private chain, and custom tokens ensure controlled research—not crypto speculation'
edits.reason: Both address governance/safety concerns. Human-in-the-loop (SL09) and brand protection (SL10) are two sides of same objection handler. Single slide addresses 'is this safe/risky?'

edits.before: 'A phased roadmap from exploratory meetings to September 2025 competition includes clear exit gates'
edits.after: 'Phased roadmap with exit gates: explore (4 weeks) → co-design → build → execute (Sept 2025)'
edits.reason: Add phase names to title for executive skim. Risk content from SL12 absorbed into this slide's notes.

edits.before: 'Key risks have specific mitigations: regulatory (private chain), security (audit), participation (Nyx community)'
edits.after: Deleted—content absorbed into SL11 roadmap slide
edits.reason: Separate risk slide is defensive. Better to address risks inline with each phase's exit criteria. Key mitigations (private chain, audit, community) already referenced elsewhere.

edits.before: SL13: '[DRAFT] 16M JPY prize pool investment generates unique educational research data as the primary ROI' + SL14: 'Next step: Approve exploratory meetings and introduce operational stakeholders for co-design'
edits.after: Merged slide: 'The ask: Approve 4-week exploratory meetings (16M JPY prize pool; operations TBD in co-design)'
edits.reason: Executive audiences want ask + cost on same slide. ROI discussion merged into CTA. Budget note preserved but de-emphasized since co-design will refine.

edits.before: 'A 4-week exploratory meeting can validate whether this AI research collaboration fits Sony's education and Soneium strategy'
edits.after: 'Request: 4-week exploratory meetings to validate AI research collaboration with Sony's education and Soneium strategy'
edits.reason: Shorten and make imperative. Executive opener should be direct ask, not conditional statement.

edits.before: 'Nyx Foundation has proven execution capability in Ethereum ecosystem research and education'
edits.after: 'Nyx has 4 years of Ethereum research credibility: 60M+ JPY raised, UTokyo partnership, ZK Tokyo community'
edits.reason: Add proof points to title. Executives skim titles; key metrics should be visible without reading bullets.

edits.before: 'The AI Agent Economy Competition creates a blockchain-based research platform where AI agents autonomously trade real assets'
edits.after: 'The proposal: 100+ teams, AI agents trading on private blockchain, L0/L1/L2 research framework'
edits.reason: Make title more scannable. Key elements (team count, private blockchain, framework) should be in title.
